scheme_name: Kalaignarin All Village Integrated Agricultural Development Programme (KAVIADP)
description: 50% direct subsidy on bio-pesticides, neem formulations, and integrated pest management kits for small and marginal farmers.
kvk_contact: Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) - Tindivanam / Kattankulathur (TNAU) | Agri Dept Helpline: 1800-425-1666
claim_procedure: Present Aadhaar Card, Chitta/Patta land records, and purchase receipt at nearest Block Primary Agricultural Co-operative Credit Society (PACCS) or Uzhavar Sandhai office.

scheme_name: National Mission on Sustainable Agriculture (NMSA) - Tamil Nadu Chapter
description: Financial assistance of ₹500/acre for soil health card-based micro-nutrient and generic pest management adoption.
kvk_contact: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Chepauk, Chennai | Uzhavan Mobile App
claim_procedure: Apply through the official TN 'Uzhavan App' by uploading your digital Soil Health Card and voucher invoice.

scheme_name: YSR Rythu Bharosa & Subsidized Input Distribution (Rythu Bharosa Kendras)
description: 45% input subsidy on certified bio-fungicides and generic pest controllers delivered via village RBKs.
kvk_contact: Rythu Bharosa Kendra (RBK) village assistance counter | Toll-Free: 155251
claim_procedure: Visit your local village RBK (Rythu Bharosa Kendra) kiosk with e-Crop booking acknowledgment number to collect subsidized input allotment directly.

scheme_name: Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Organic Farming Mission & Mahadbt Pest Management Subsidy
description: 50% reimbursement for generic micro-nutrients and IPM bio-agents to combat cotton bollworms and soybean fungal diseases.
kvk_contact: KVK Baramati / KVK Karda (Washim) | MahaDBT Farmer Portal Helpline: 022-49150800
claim_procedure: Submit claim on MahaDBT Farmer Portal under 'Krushi Yojana' with GST bill from authorized IFFCO / Krishi Seva Kendra within 30 days of purchase.

scheme_name: Punjab State Crop Diversification & Plant Protection Subsidy Scheme
description: 50% grant on recommended generic plant protection chemicals and trichogramma parasitoid cards for wheat, paddy, and cotton.
kvk_contact: PAU Krishi Vigyan Kendra Ludhiana / Bathinda | Kisan Call Centre: 1800-180-1551
claim_procedure: Verify eligibility with Block Agriculture Officer (BAO) and submit PAU-approved chemist bill for direct bank transfer (DBT).

scheme_name: UP Pardarshi Kisan Seva Yojana - Plant Protection Grant
description: Up to 50% DBT grant on certified generic agrochemicals, neem oils, and micronutrient kits.
kvk_contact: KVK Kanpur Dehat / Varanasi | UP Agriculture Helpline: 1800-180-1551
claim_procedure: Direct benefit transfer credited within 15 days upon registering transaction on pardarshi kisan portal (upagripardarshi.gov.in).

scheme_name: Sub-Mission on Plant Protection & Plant Quarantine (SMPPQ) / NFSM
description: National support scheme providing up to 40% reimbursement on bio-pesticides and generic IPM chemicals.
kvk_contact: Central Kisan Call Centre (Toll-Free 1800-180-1551) & Nearest ICAR-KVK Center
claim_procedure: Enroll via PM-Kisan linked credentials at local Krishi Vigyan Kendra or CSC (Common Service Center).
